meta.description: FileMaker Pro field type capability catalog. Answers 'what can a field of this type do' — which options apply, how storage and indexing behave, what each summary type computes. Scope is the developer-facing capability surface in Manage Database, NOT the XML/SaXML shape a field definition serialises to.
meta.scope_note: This catalog does not describe field-definition XML. For paste-ready field definition XML (fmxmlsnippet FMObjectList with Field elements, auto-enter/validation/storage element structure, and the paste-handler rules that cause silent failures), use the filemaker-field-xml skill — it is the authoritative source for that layer and is deliberately not duplicated here.
meta.verification_method: Re-derived from live help.claris.com pro-help pages: choosing-a-field-type, text-fields, number-fields, date-fields, time-fields, timestamp-fields, container-fields, calculation-fields, summary-fields, field-indexing-options, field-validation, setting-field-options, advanced-field-options, external-storage-container-data, global-fields, repeating-fields.
meta.persistent_data_note: The FM 26 persistent data store is NOT a field type and NOT a field storage option. It is a per-file, schema-resident named-value store (Name + optional Instance ID) that lives outside record data. Its values may be any of the six data types below, which is the only relationship to this catalog. Written with the Configure Persistent Data script step; read with GetPersistentData / ListPersistentDataIDs. See references/specialty-functions-examples.md and script-steps-catalog.json (Persistent Data category).

data_types.name: Text
data_types.stores: Letters, symbols and/or numbers used as text, per field repetition, limited by available RAM and disk space
data_types.sorts_as: Alphabetical — character by character, so 11 sorts before 2. Use Number (or a calculation/summary with a numeric result) for numeric ordering.

data_types.name: Number
data_types.stores: Digits or other characters, and the negative values of the same range

data_types.name: Timestamp
data_types.stores: Dates and times together, referencing a fixed point in calendar time

data_types.name: Container
data_types.stores: A file of any type — picture, PDF, audio, video
data_types.fm26_change: Container fields now support WebP images.

field_types.name: Normal
field_types.description: A field that stores entered data directly. Takes one of the six data types above.

field_types.name: Calculation
field_types.description: Returns the result of a calculation formula using values from the current record or related records.
field_types.storage_note: May be stored (indexable) or unstored. Unstored calculations cannot be indexed and evaluate on demand.

field_types.name: Summary
field_types.description: Produces a value by summarising a field's values across more than one record in the same table.
field_types.behaviour_note: The value depends on layout placement, the size of the found set, and the sort order. Only non-blank values are included. Recalculates when the underlying data or the found set changes.

summary_types.name: Total of
summary_types.computes: The total of values in the field

summary_types.name: Average of
summary_types.computes: The average of values in the field

summary_types.name: Count of
summary_types.computes: The number of records containing a value for the field

summary_types.name: Minimum
summary_types.computes: The lowest number, or earliest date, time or timestamp

summary_types.name: Maximum
summary_types.computes: The highest number, or latest date, time or timestamp

summary_types.name: Standard Deviation of
summary_types.computes: How widely values differ from the mean of the field's values

summary_types.name: Fraction of Total of
summary_types.computes: The ratio of the field's value to the total of all values in that field

summary_types.name: List of
summary_types.computes: A return-delimited list of values in the field

value_index.used_for: Joining related records; searches in number, date, time and timestamp fields and calculations returning those types

word_index.cost_note: Stores each unique word in the field. Large text fields generate large indexes and can significantly increase file size.

indexing.guidance: For normal use choose None or Minimal and select 'Automatically create indexes as needed'. Indexes speed searches but increase file size.

global.description: A field with global storage holds one value shared across all records in the file; per-user and per-session for a hosted file.

repeating.description: Stores more than one value in a single field, addressed by repetition number.
repeating.set_via: Options for Field, Storage tab, 'Maximum number of repetitions'

container_external.description: Container data may be embedded, or stored externally as Open or Secure storage.

advanced_options.description: Set via the Advanced button in the Fields tab of Manage Database (also reachable by double-clicking the field in FM 26).

options.name: Add annotation in Data Definition Language (DDL)
options.purpose: Free text describing the field's purpose. Included as a code comment after the field's definition in generated DDL. Primary use is improving an AI model's ability to generate SQL from the schema.
options.important: When ANY field in a table is annotated, only annotated fields are included in that table's generated DDL. When no field is annotated, all fields are included using their comment text.

options.name: Customize field display names
options.purpose: A JSON object of key-value pairs setting an alternate display name per feature, for when the real field name would not be understood by users.

fm26_additions: Customizable field display names for export, sort and table view (Advanced Options).
DDL annotations per field (Advanced Options), read with FieldAnnotation().
Auto-enter lookup 'Don't copy contents if empty' state is preserved in add-ons.
A Schema tab in File Options controls defaults for newly created fields.
The Advanced Options for Field dialog is reachable by double-clicking the field.
